title: Aerobic Exercise Prescription — Heart Rate, Talk Test and 150 Minutes

hook.en: Walking, cycling and swimming protect the heart, lower blood sugar and lift mood, but only when the dose is right. Learn to prescribe aerobic exercise with numbers a patient can actually use: heart-rate zones, the talk test and weekly minutes.
hook.ur: Chalna, cycling aur tairaki dil ki hifazat karte hain, blood sugar kam karte hain aur mood behtar karte hain, magar sirf sahi dosage par. Aerobic exercise aise numbers ke saath likhna seekhein jo mareez waqai istemal kar sake: heart-rate zones, talk test aur hafte ke minute.

goal.en: By the end, you'll write a full aerobic prescription (frequency, intensity, time, type), calculate a target heart-rate range with the Karvonen formula, use the talk test and RPE when heart rate is unreliable, and progress the dose safely.
goal.ur: End tak aap poora aerobic nuskha (frequency, intensity, time, type) likhenge, Karvonen formula se target heart-rate range nikalenge, jab heart rate qabil-e-aitbaar na ho to talk test aur RPE istemal karenge, aur dosage ko mehfooz tareeqe se barhayenge.

text.en: Adults are advised to do **150 to 300 minutes a week of moderate** aerobic activity, or **75 to 150 minutes of vigorous** activity, plus muscle strengthening on 2 or more days. **Moderate** means you can talk but not sing; **vigorous** means you can say only a few words. Any amount is better than none: for someone inactive, even 10 minutes a day is a real gain. The dose is written with **FITT**: Frequency, Intensity, Time and Type.
text.ur: Baalighon ko hafte mein **150 se 300 minute darmiyani** aerobic activity, ya **75 se 150 minute tez** activity, aur 2 ya zyada din muscle strengthening ka mashwara hai. **Darmiyani** ka matlab hai aap baat kar sakte hain magar ga nahi sakte; **tez** ka matlab hai aap sirf chand alfaaz bol sakte hain. Kuch na karne se thora karna behtar hai: ghair fa'aal shakhs ke liye roz 10 minute bhi asal faida hai. Dosage **FITT** se likhi jati hai: Frequency, Intensity, Time aur Type.

text.en: Aerobic dosing is like **cooking on a stove**. Too low a flame and the food never cooks (no training effect); too high and it burns (injury, exhaustion, cardiac risk). The heart-rate zone and the talk test are your **flame knob**, and minutes per week are the **cooking time**.
text.ur: Aerobic dosage **chulhe par khana pakane** jaisi hai. Aag bohat kam ho to khana pakta hi nahi (training ka asar nahi); bohat tez ho to jal jata hai (chot, thakan, dil ka khatra). Heart-rate zone aur talk test aap ka **aag ka knob** hain, aur hafte ke minute **pakane ka waqt**.

steps.title: Screen and set a goal
steps.detail: Ask about heart or lung disease, diabetes, symptoms on exertion and medicines (beta-blockers flatten heart rate). Agree a goal the patient cares about, such as walking to the mosque without stopping. || Screen karein aur goal tay karein

steps.title: Calculate the heart-rate range
steps.detail: Estimate maximum heart rate (about 220 minus age, or 208 minus 0.7 times age). Karvonen: target = resting HR + intensity x (max HR − resting HR). Moderate is about 40 to 59 percent of this reserve; vigorous is 60 to 89 percent. || Heart-rate range nikalein

steps.title: Add the talk test and RPE
steps.detail: Teach the patient: "You should be able to talk in sentences but not sing." On the 0 to 10 effort scale, moderate is about 3 to 4 and vigorous 5 to 6. Use these alone when heart rate is unreliable. || Talk test aur RPE shamil karein

steps.title: Start low and progress
steps.detail: Begin with what the patient can do (for example 10 minutes, 5 days a week), add 5 minutes per session every week or two, then raise intensity once 30 minutes is comfortable. Include a 5-minute warm-up and cool-down. || Kam se shuru karein aur barhayein

question.en: A 60-year-old has a resting heart rate of 70. Using 220 minus age and 50 percent of heart-rate reserve, what is the target?
question.ur: 60 saal ke shakhs ka resting heart rate 70 hai. 220 minus umar aur heart-rate reserve ke 50 percent se target kya hai?

feedback.en: That is half of the maximum, not of the reserve, which is too low.
feedback.ur: Yeh maximum ka aadha hai, reserve ka nahi, aur bohat kam hai.

feedback.en: Yes — max 160, reserve 90, half is 45, plus 70 gives 115.
feedback.ur: Haan — max 160, reserve 90, aadha 45, plus 70 se 115.

feedback.en: That is near maximum: vigorous, not moderate.
feedback.ur: Yeh maximum ke qareeb hai: tez, darmiyani nahi.

rows.en: Can talk in sentences, cannot sing
Only a few words at a time
rows.ur: Ek waqt mein sirf chand alfaaz

text.en: **FITT, then talk.** Write Frequency, Intensity, Time and Type, and give the patient one simple check they can feel: "talk, but don't sing".
text.ur: **FITT, phir baat.** Frequency, Intensity, Time aur Type likhein, aur mareez ko ek aasan jaanch dein jo woh mehsoos kar sake: "baat karein, gaayein nahi".

text.en: **Using heart-rate targets in a patient on beta-blockers.** These medicines keep the heart rate low, so the patient may push far too hard chasing a number. Use RPE and the talk test instead, or a heart rate measured during an exercise test on the same medicine.
text.ur: **Beta-blockers wale mareez mein heart-rate targets istemal karna.** Yeh dawaiyan heart rate kam rakhti hain, is liye mareez number ke peeche bohat zyada zor laga sakta hai. Is ki jagah RPE aur talk test istemal karein, ya usi dawai par exercise test mein naapa gaya heart rate.

question.en: Which patient should you use RPE and the talk test for instead of heart rate?
question.ur: Kis mareez ke liye heart rate ki jagah RPE aur talk test istemal karna chahiye?

text.en: A teenager with an ankle sprain

feedback.en: There is no reason heart rate would be unreliable.
feedback.ur: Heart rate ghair-qabil-e-aitbaar hone ki koi wajah nahi.

text.en: A man taking bisoprolol for high blood pressure
text.ur: Hai blood pressure ke liye bisoprolol lene wala shakhs

feedback.en: Yes — beta-blockers blunt the heart-rate response.
feedback.ur: Haan — beta-blockers heart rate ke response ko dabate hain.

feedback.en: Heart rate works well for him.
feedback.ur: Us ke liye heart rate theek kaam karta hai.

question.en: An inactive patient can walk only 10 minutes. What is the best first step?
question.ur: Ek ghair fa'aal mareez sirf 10 minute chal sakta hai. Behtareen pehla qadam kya hai?

text.en: Wait until they are fitter before starting

feedback.en: Starting small is how they become fitter.
feedback.ur: Thora shuru karna hi fit hone ka tareeqa hai.

text.en: 10 minutes most days at a moderate pace, adding about 5 minutes every week or two
text.ur: Aksar din 10 minute darmiyani raftaar se, har ek do hafte baad takreeban 5 minute barha kar

feedback.en: Yes — start where the patient is and build gradually.
feedback.ur: Haan — mareez jahan hai wahan se shuru karein aur aahista barhayein.

feedback.en: Too much, too soon: risk of pain and drop-out.
feedback.ur: Bohat zyada, bohat jaldi: dard aur chhor dene ka khatra.

text.en: **Prescribe in the patient's life.** A brisk walk to the market, climbing stairs at home or cycling to work all count. In hot weather, advise early morning or evening, water, and light clothes. For people fasting in Ramadan, moving the session to after iftar is usually easier and safer.
text.ur: **Mareez ki zindagi mein nuskha dein.** Bazaar tak tez chalna, ghar mein seedhiyan chadhna ya kaam par cycle chalana sab shumar hota hai. Garmi mein subah sawere ya shaam, pani aur halke kapre ka mashwara dein. Ramzan mein roza rakhne walon ke liye session iftar ke baad karna aam taur par aasan aur mehfooz hota hai.

question.en: Why is 220 minus age only an estimate?
question.ur: 220 minus umar sirf andaza kyun hai?

answer.en: Real maximum heart rate varies by about 10 to 12 beats either way between people of the same age, so the formula can be well off for an individual. That is why the talk test and RPE are always used alongside it, and why an exercise test gives the most accurate number for people with heart disease.
answer.ur: Ek hi umar ke logon mein asal maximum heart rate takreeban 10 se 12 beats upar neeche hota hai, is liye formula kisi khaas shakhs ke liye kaafi ghalat ho sakta hai. Isi liye talk test aur RPE hamesha saath istemal hote hain, aur dil ki bimari walon ke liye exercise test sab se durust number deta hai.

beats.patient: A 52-year-old shopkeeper with type 2 diabetes and knee osteoarthritis wants to "get fit". He is inactive, his resting heart rate is 78, he takes metformin only and has no chest pain or breathlessness on exertion.
beats.assessment: He is suitable for moderate aerobic exercise; low-impact types will suit his knees.
beats.treatment: Start with cycling or walking 15 minutes, 5 days a week, at a "talk but not sing" effort (about 104 to 120 beats per minute by Karvonen), building by 5 minutes a fortnight towards 30 minutes, plus two days of strengthening.
beats.reassess: After three months he walks 30 minutes daily, his blood sugar has improved and his knee pain is no worse.

text.en: **Stop exercise and seek help** for chest pain or pressure, unusual breathlessness, dizziness or fainting, palpitations, or new confusion. **Get medical clearance first** for people with known heart disease, symptoms on exertion, uncontrolled blood pressure (for example above 180/110), or unstable diabetes. People taking insulin or sulfonylureas should check their blood sugar before and after exercise and carry a quick sugar.
text.ur: **Exercise rok kar madad lein** seene mein dard ya dabao, ghair mamooli saans phoolna, chakkar ya behoshi, dil ki dharkan tez mehsoos hona, ya nayi uljhan par. **Pehle medical ijazat lein** dil ki maloom bimari, mehnat par alamaat, be-qaboo blood pressure (maslan 180/110 se zyada), ya be-qaboo diabetes walon ke liye. Insulin ya sulfonylureas lene wale exercise se pehle aur baad blood sugar check karein aur fori sugar saath rakhein.

summary.en: Adults need 150 to 300 minutes of moderate (or 75 to 150 of vigorous) aerobic activity a week, written with FITT.
summary.ur: Baalighon ko hafte mein 150 se 300 minute darmiyani (ya 75 se 150 tez) aerobic activity chahiye, FITT se likhi hui.

summary.en: Karvonen: target = resting HR + intensity x (max HR − resting HR); moderate is 40 to 59 percent of the reserve.
summary.ur: Karvonen: target = resting HR + intensity x (max HR − resting HR); darmiyani reserve ka 40 se 59 percent hai.

summary.en: The talk test and RPE are simple, reliable checks, essential with beta-blockers; start low and progress gradually.
summary.ur: Talk test aur RPE aasan, qabil-e-aitbaar jaanch hain, beta-blockers ke saath zaroori; kam se shuru karein aur aahista barhayein.

front.ur: Baalighon ke liye hafte ka aerobic target?

back.en: 150 to 300 minutes moderate, or 75 to 150 minutes vigorous.
back.ur: 150 se 300 minute darmiyani, ya 75 se 150 minute tez.

back.en: Target HR = resting HR + intensity x (max HR − resting HR).
back.ur: Target HR = resting HR + intensity x (max HR − resting HR).

front.en: The talk test for moderate intensity?

back.en: You can talk in full sentences but cannot sing.
back.ur: Aap poore jumlon mein baat kar sakte hain magar ga nahi sakte.

front.en: Why avoid heart-rate targets with beta-blockers?
front.ur: Beta-blockers ke saath heart-rate targets se kyun bachein?

back.en: The medicine keeps heart rate low, so targets lead to over-exertion; use RPE instead.
back.ur: Dawai heart rate kam rakhti hai, is liye targets zyada mehnat karwate hain; RPE istemal karein.
